title: Clamp with parameters
prompt: The robot's speed must stay between a low and a high limit. Return value, but never lower than low and never higher than high. Godot has a built-in for exactly this. clamp_value(15, 0, 10) is 10.
starter:
func clamp_value(value, low, high):
	return value

tests.name: Inside the limits stays the same
Too low becomes the low limit
Too high becomes the high limit

hints: Built-in functions take parameters too, in a fixed order.
clamp takes value, low, high, in the same order as yours.

docs.name: clamp(value, low, high)
docs.what: Returns value, but never lower than low or higher than high.

solution:
func clamp_value(value, low, high):
	return clamp(value, low, high)
